candidates.title: Master the Kettlebell Clean and Snatch with This Basic Drill #kettlebells
candidates.description:
The DEAD clean or snatch is a great way to clean up or learn the clean and snatch.
I use this as my primary movement with new clients regardless of their fitness level.

Here's how to do it:
Place the kettlebell between your feet, closer to the heels.
Fold at the hips keeping your chest tall and proud.
Rip the kettlebell off the floor in one swift motion allowing the bell to go over the hand.

The primary reason for this movement is to keep the kettlebell close to the body the entire time to reduce the impact on the forearm.
